            }

        <div class="subscriber-preview"><p>SAINT PAUL, Minn.—If symbolism can come in small packages, ‘The Calling’ is on the bigger side. At 25 tons and nearly three storeys tall, the sculpture of a loon, wings outspread, would cast quite the shadow over Allianz Field were it not peppered with holes letting light pour through 50,000 steel feathers.</p></div><div class="subscriber-preview"><p>A shimmering, enormous instalment of the bird that Canada treasures as a national symbol but is the official feathered friend of this American state feels perfectly placed this week. There has been a sense for some time that the whole “more that unites us than separates us” shtick is exactly backward when it comes to <a href="https://www.thestar.com/opinion/contributors/mark-carney-has-taught-canadians-how-to-handle-a-global-bully/article_c8ace154-d365-4768-8aa3-d3760bd0d015.html" target="_blank">Canada-U.S. relations.</a> But in the field of international football, these neighbours have arguably never needed one another more.</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>Fresh off a <a href="https://www.thestar.com/sports/soccer/world-cup/" target="_blank">World Cup</a> where both co-hosts marched into the last 16 and underlined their status as consistent big-game performers, the search for high-calibre dance partners has become a vexing thing. Match calendars are becoming more log-jammed and now Asia’s confederation is primed to follow Europe and Africa in essentially doing away with friendlies. On the path to the 2030 World Cup, which both <a href="https://www.thestar.com/sports/soccer/world-cup/canadas-coach-is-arriving-at-his-first-world-cup-moment-these-moments-around-the-world-made-jesse-marsch/article_bb528800-b165-40d3-8e63-862387db55b0.html" target="_blank">Jesse Marsch</a> and southern counterpart <a href="https://www.thestar.com/sports/soccer/us-coach-pochettino-regrets-his-limited-role-in-balogun-red-card-appeal-at-the-world-cup/article_1bf2585c-d6cc-5b2c-a2c9-f42e8d629fdf.html" target="_blank">Mauricio Pochettino</a> have signed on for, these are two teams that will see an awful lot of each other.</p></div><div id="tncms-region-article_instory_top" class="tncms-region hidden-print tsArticleRegion "><div id="tncms-block-3428475" class="tncms-block"><div class="article-pe-video-wrapper">
    <div class="adLabelWrapperManual mobileVideoRunway hidden-print" style="clear:right">
        <span class="label-article-continues">ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW</span>
        <div id="primis" class="videoElement">
        <!-- Code from Primis (Home) -->
        <script type="text/javascript" language="javascript" src="https://live.primis.tech/live/liveView.php?s=122439&vp_content=plembed3ed2linysjgv&cbuster=%%CACHEBUSTER%%"></script>
        <!-- End of code from Primis -->
        </div>
    </div>
</div></div></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>Throughout this two-week window, Canadian players outlined that a first trophy in a quarter century is the immediate goal. To fulfil that, whether at next year’s CONCACAF Nations League or Gold Cup, they’ll surely have to go through the Americans.</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>There will be no hardware on offer Tuesday night but there’s still plenty at stake. Of all Marsch’s achievements in two-and-a-half years at the helm, turning this fixture into a legitimate and heated rivalry already felt consequential. As he endeavours to drive his team continually upward in this cycle, adding fresh layers to these duels with his homeland will only help.</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>Unlike any predecessor, Marsch does it off the field, too. He caused a fresh stir over the weekend when he told The Guardian that <a href="https://www.thestar.com/sports/soccer/what-to-know-about-fifas-stunning-decision-to-lift-the-suspension-of-us-player-balogun/article_cd123e1c-0f56-5e47-8253-93835fd81f59.html" target="_blank">the Folarin Balogun affair</a>, when U.S. President Donald Trump intervened to help persuade FIFA to inexplicably lift a World Cup ban on the striker, “is why everyone around the world hates America.” This fixture’s familiarity doesn’t need to breed contempt. Marsch already provides plenty, even if he looked for more diplomatic tones Monday.</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>“I don’t really care what people think, too much. But obviously I’m also making polarizing statements at times,” Marsch said. “I’m not afraid to say things that I think need to be said. I’ve a unique perspective being an American and having a bit of a Canadian mentality and representing a really important role in the nation. When I believe there’s things that need to be stood up for, I do that.”</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>Marsch was joined by Dayne St. Clair and Tani Oluwaseyi for the pre-match chat. Afterward, as Canada began training, both were presented with jackets honouring them as members of Minnesota United’s team of the decade, the club’s loon logo in bright sky blue. Canada’s squad is speckled with players who represent American MLS sides. More are European club teammates with U.S. players. Yet threads that bind both squads loosen on days like these.</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>“The big talk in America is Lake Ontario (or) Lake America, this kind of crap, but in the end I don’t have to sit in front of the guys and say, ‘OK, we’re playing the U.S., this is important’,” Marsch said. “They don’t need reminders.”</p><div class='article-pe-billboard-wrapper subscriber-hide'>

        <div id="article-instory-1" class="tnt-ads dfp-ad" data-lazy="true" data-refresh="true" data-bidding-refresh="true" >
            <script>

                });

        </div>
    </div></div></div></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>Between 1885 and 2024, Canada had beaten the U.S. on American soil just twice. In came Marsch and that number is now four. An away win Tuesday would give Canada three in a row for the first time since 1968.</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>“We want to be the beacon of the region and we believe we can be,” said Marsch, spurned for the U.S. job before he took the Canadian reins. “I believe the rivalry is better than it’s ever been, more because the two teams are good.”</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>His words and actions play a huge part, too. In the last meeting, Marsch was sent off for a sideline outburst. St. Clair joked he’d “take a (Marsch) red card tomorrow if it means a win.”</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>Back-to-back victories over Chile and Peru made the World Cup homecoming a very gratifying one. That they were achieved without Alphonso Davies, Moïse Bombito, Ismaël Koné, Alistair Johnston and Max Crépeau — nearly half of a first-choice XI — is even more impressive.</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>Marsch will likely go as strong as possible in Saint Paul against a youthful, experimental home side. Nathan Saliba has had a stellar window in the heart of midfield, with Jacob Shaffelburg revitalized outside him. Luc de Fougerolles and Ralph Priso have grown into their unexpected defensive partnership. Oluwaseyi looks likely to join Jonathan David in attack.</p></div><div class="subscriber-only" style="display:none"><p>Breakout Minnesota attacker Marcus Caldeira joined the squad here and could see a rapid debut. If so, he’ll swap his loon crest for a maple leaf. Familiarity and symbols everywhere.</p></div>

    // Prepublish Event Handler   
    prepublishEventHandler = (channel, event, ...args) => {
        //console.log(channel + ' ' + event + ' ' + args[0]  + ' ' + args[1]);
        if (!TNCMS.User.isLoggedIn()) {
            if (channel === 'authentication' && (event === 'required' || event === 'needed')){
                // Follow Flag Clicked
                $('#viafoura-modal').modal('show');
                return false;
            } else if (channel === 'tray' && event === 'opened' && args.length > 0 && (args[0] === 'vf-feed' || args[0] === 'vf-profile')) {
                // Open tray with Bell or Profile icon
                if (args[0] === 'vf-profile') {
                    window.vf.$publish('tray', 'close');
                    window.vf.$publish('tray', 'open');
                }
                this.setTrayHeader();
            }
        } else {
            if (channel === 'authentication' && (event === 'required' || event === 'needed')) { // Update Profile button Clicked
                $('#modal-comment-update-profile').modal('show');
                return false;
            } else {             
                const userFirstName = TNCMS.User.getFirstName(),
                      userLastName  = TNCMS.User.getLastName();
                      
                if (userFirstName == '' || userLastName == '') {
                    if (channel === 'tray-tab' && event === 'change' && args[0] === 'vf-profile') {
                        // Don't allow users with missing name information to view vf-profile
                        window.vf.$publish('tray', 'close');
                    }
                } else {
                    if (channel === 'tray-tab' && event === 'change' && args.length === 1 && args[0] === 'vf-profile') {
                        // Close tray and redirect to CMS user profile when clicking on widget profile
                        window.vf.$publish('tray', 'close');
                        window.location = 'https://www.thestar.com/users/admin/profile/edit/?itm_source=conversation-tray';
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return {
            channel,
            event,
            args,
        }
    };
    
    // User Event Handler
    userEventHandler = (user) => {
        if (TNCMS.User.isLoggedIn()) {
            let tncmsUserName,
                validUserName = false;
            if (TNCMS.User.getFirstName() != undefined)
            {
                tncmsUserName = TNCMS.User.getFirstName() + ' ' + TNCMS.User.getLastName();
                validUserName = (TNCMS.User.getFirstName().length === 0 || TNCMS.User.getLastName().length === 0 || TNCMS.User.getFirstName().length == null || TNCMS.User.getLastName().length == null) ? false : true;
            } else {
                tncmsUserName = "Reader";
                validUserName = false;
            }
                        
            if (user.name !== tncmsUserName) {
                // Viafoura user doesn't match TNCMS user.
                window.vf.session.logout().then(() => {
                    if (validUserName) {
                        if(user.name.toLowerCase() === 'guest') {
                            // Generate Token and Viafoura OpenID login.
                            generateToken().then((token) => {
                                window.vf.session.login.openIdConnect(token);
                             });

                            if(sessionStorage.getItem('bd-viafoura-oidc')) {
                                let oidcToken = sessionStorage.getItem('bd-viafoura-oidc');
                                window.vf.session.login.openIdConnect(oidcToken);
                            } else {
                                // Generate Token and Viafoura OpenID login.
                                generateToken().then((token) => {
                                    window.vf.session.login.openIdConnect(token);
                                });
                            }
                         }   
                    } else { // First and last name isn't defined.
                        document.getElementById('comment-update-profile').style.display = 'block';
                        generateToken().then((token) => {
                            const decodedToken = jwt_decode(token);
                            const givenName = decodedToken['given_name'];
                            if(givenName) { // Generate Token and Viafoura OpenID login.
                                document.getElementById('comment-update-profile').style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
                                window.vf.session.login.openIdConnect(token);
                            }
                         });
                    }
                });
            }
        } else {
            window.vf.session.logout()
              .then(() => {
                console.log('Logged out');
              })
              .catch(err => console.error(err));
        }
    };
    
    getWithExpiry = (key) => {
        const itemStr = localStorage.getItem(key);    
        if (!itemStr) {
            return null;
        }   
        const item = JSON.parse(itemStr);   
        if (Date.now() > item.expiry) {
            localStorage.removeItem(key);
            return null;
        }   
        return item.value;
    }

    // Token Generator
    generateToken = () => {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const params = new FormData;
            params.append('client_id', '010CBDE6F40611EDB48D1B30C889B9BE');
            params.append('scope', 'profile email');
            
            // CSRF Token Support
            const csrfTokenViafoura = Cookies.get('tncms_csrf_token');
            if (csrfTokenViafoura) params.append('tncms_csrf_token', csrfTokenViafoura);
            
            fetch('/tncms/oidc/generate_token', {method: 'POST', body: params})
                .then(resp => resp.json())
                .then(resp => {
                    if ( resp.error ) {
                        console.log(resp.error);
                    } else {
                        sessionStorage.setItem('bd-viafoura-oidc',resp.id_token);
                        resolve(resp.id_token);
                    }
                })
                .catch(error => window.alert('ERROR: '+ error.message));

        function csrfDatetime() {
            const salt = "aIojjNzJ";
            const now = new Date();
            const epochTime = now.getTime();
            const manipulatedNumber = (epochTime * 12345) + 67890;
            const manipulatedString = manipulatedNumber.toString().split('').reverse().join('') + salt;
            const disguised = btoa(manipulatedString);
            return disguised;
        }
            
        async function newsletterHashData(data) {
            const encoder = new TextEncoder();
            const dataUint8Array = encoder.encode(data);
            const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', dataUint8Array);
            const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer)); // Convert buffer to byte array
            const hashHex = hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''); // Convert bytes to hex string
            return hashHex;
        }
        
        async function subscribeNewUserToNewsletter(theOptions) {
            let listid = theOptions.listid;
            let realm = theOptions.realm;
            let NLdomain = theOptions.domain;
            let domainAlias = theOptions.domainAlias;
            let currentUserEmail = theOptions.user_email;
            let newStorageEmail = theOptions.new_storage_email;
            var myHeaders = new Headers();
            myHeaders.append("Content-Type", "application/json");
            myHeaders.append("Host", "new_storage_email");

            const recaptchaResponse = "";
            const userToken = Cookies.get('tncms-user');

            var raw;
            const source = {
                "platform": "web",
                "property": domainAlias,
                "type": "automatic",
                "place": "modal_purchase_success",
                "url": window.location.href,
                "userAgent": navigator.userAgent,
                "blockId": "",
                "timestamp": new Date().toISOString(),
                "action": "sub"
            };
            if (userToken) {
                raw = JSON.stringify({
                  "email": currentUserEmail,
                  "origin": domainAlias,
                  "token": userToken,
                  "source": source
                });
            } else {
                raw = JSON.stringify({
                  "email": currentUserEmail,
                  "origin": domainAlias,
                  "source": source
                });
            }

            const hash = await newsletterHashData(raw);
            myHeaders.append("x-data-integrity", hash);

            var requestOptions = {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: myHeaders,
              body: raw,
              redirect: 'follow'
            };

            fetch("https://" + NLdomain + "/newsletters/v2/subscription?realm=" + realm + "&listid=" + listid, requestOptions)
              .then(response => response.text())
              .then(result => { 
                  let message = JSON.parse(result);
                  if((message?.error?.code ?? -1) === 0) {
                      return;
                  } else if(message.code == 200) {  
                      window.localStorage.setItem("tncms-firstupsubscribed", newStorageEmail);
                      sessionStorage.removeItem("tncms-disclaimer-checked");
                  }
                  else {
                      console.log("error");
                      console.log(message.code);
                  }                      
              })
              .catch(error => console.log('error', error));
        }
